code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    for r,c in seeds:
        for dc,v in [(-1,1),(0,6),(1,6)]:
            cc=c+dc
            if 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[r][cc]=v
    return out
'''
